mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL (yoy) > 3.5, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and employment (PAYEMS) signals robust economic growth, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 100 and PAYEMS > 156000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 305), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 305, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals strong economic activity, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO has increased over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.0%, it signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and a hawkish monetary policy response, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a restrictive monetary policy cycle, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0 and CPIAUCSL > 305, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In tight labor market regimes (UNRATE < 3.0 and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% year-over-year), wage pressures may lead to inflationary concerns, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.0 and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% (yoy), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
